def test_by_length():
    assert by_length([2, 1, 1, 4, 3]) == ["Four", "Three", "Two", "One", "One"]
    assert by_length([8, 8, 8]) == ["Eight", "Eight", "Eight"]
    assert by_length([]) == []
    assert by_length([10, 0, -1, 100]) == []          # out of range -> dropped
    assert by_length([9, 5, 12, 1]) == ["Nine", "Five", "One"]  # mixed
    assert by_length([1]) == ["One"]
